subject: [video] build_ios.sh: avc2 and avc/ must not both provide n2avc_* (duplicate symbols)
body: For the stage-1 plug-in, the chosen core is the lead's avc2. build_ios.sh currently globs avc/*.c, which includes WP03's n2avc_enc.c and helpers defining n2avc_open/headers/encode/reconfigure/close; linking both that and avc2/n2avc_core.c will duplicate those symbols. The working source set (the one my WP05 real test and the lead's avc2/build_cli.sh use) is: avc2/n2avc_core.c + avc/n2avc_inter.c + avc/n2avc_me.c + avc/n2avc_rc.c + kern/n2vk_ref.c + kern/n2vk_dispatch.c, with -pthread and -lm on the host. Suggested rule: if avc2/n2avc_core.c exists, use that set for the dylib instead of the avc/*.c glob; otherwise keep the current avc/ glob. This is script-owned by you; no WP05 file changes. My forced/default real test already links that exact set and passes 10x176x144 with a clean ffmpeg decode (N2TEST WP05 PASS 1041/1041).
